docs/threads.md:62:- Untracked files that match a glob in `worktree_snapshot_exclude` (default empty). A glob without `/` matches the file name (`.env*` matches `config/.env.local`). A glob with `/` matches the full path. `**` matches across directories.
docs/threads.md:64:These limits apply to untracked files only. Changes to tracked files are always saved. When pi-action does not save a file, the message to pi in the next run lists the file and the reason.
docs/threads.md:116:All people who can read the repository can read `refs/pi/worktrees/*`, also the untracked files in the snapshots. Make git ignore files with secrets, or add them to `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Security](security.md#thread-contents-are-visible).
README.md:104:| `worktree_snapshot_exclude` | Globs of untracked files never to save in a snapshot, one per line or comma-separated, for example `.env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*`. Ignored files are never saved | No | - |

action.yml:191:        INPUT_WORKTREE_SNAPSHOT_EXCLUDE: ${{ inputs.worktree_snapshot_exclude }}
